title: Schedule of Service, Location and Statutory Charges on Car Hire
content:
Besides the rate for the vehicle, a Wanderlane car rental carries an agency service fee, charges that
depend on where the vehicle is collected and returned, and statutory charges. The schedule sets out each of
them for all six Car Rental Rate Classes.

| Rate class | Agency service fee, once per rental, in USD | Return to another branch, in USD | Vehicle may cross an international border | Cross-border charge, in USD | Airport collection surcharge, as a percentage | Vehicle licensing recovery, per rental day, in USD | Sales tax, as a percentage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 14.95 | 175 | no | 0 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 12.95 | 150 | no | 0 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 9.95 | 125 | yes | 89 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 9.95 | 95 | yes | 69 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0 | 0 | yes | 0 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 0 | 85 | yes | 55 | 9 | 3.5 | 8.75 |

## Points of judgement on the schedule

**A cross-border charge of nothing is not the same as permission.** The Pay Now Saver Rate and the Pay Now
Standard Rate carry a cross-border charge of nothing because neither class lets the vehicle leave the
country at all. The Premium Inclusive Rate also carries a charge of nothing, but it does permit the
crossing; on that class the crossing is simply free.

**The statutory columns are nearly uniform.** Sales tax stands at 8.75 per cent on every one of the six
classes. The airport surcharge stands at 11.5 per cent on five of them and at 9 per cent on the Corporate
Negotiated Drive Rate; the licensing recovery stands at 4.25 USD a day on five and at 3.5 USD on the same
class.

**The agency service fee falls as the class rises.** It is 14.95 USD on the Pay Now Saver Rate, 12.95 USD on
the Pay Now Standard Rate, 9.95 USD on both the Pay At Counter Flex Rate and the Inclusive Flex Rate, and
nothing on the Premium Inclusive Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate.
